text: Stephen Bunting opens his Grand Slam of Darts on Saturday against Raymond Smith, in a new three-player group format where only the group winner advances.
The 2-7 Jets host the 7-1 Bills on Sunday with 36-year-old Geno Smith at quarterback and Garrett Wilson still in concussion protocol.
The Mets have a meeting set with Tarik Skubal, the two-time Cy Young winner and top free agent, who reportedly wants a deal before a possible 2 December lockout.
New England Test coach Stephen Fleming's first squad, for South Africa, drops spinner Shoaib Bashir for uncapped Liam Patterson-White and brings back Jacob Bethell.
Shaun Murphy reached the Champion of Champions semi-finals without losing a frame, whitewashing Ronnie O'Sullivan 4-0 and then Chang Bingyu 6-0.
Yokozuna Hoshoryu, back from knee surgery, has slumped to 2-4 after five days in Fukuoka, while Atamifuji is the only unbeaten wrestler at 5-0.
Canada's Matt Dunstone beat Scotland's Bruce Mouat 7-6 to retain the Grand Slam of Curling Masters title; the tour moves to Nova Scotia next week.
Mercedes clinched their first F1 constructors' title since 2021 in Brazil, a week after 20-year-old Kimi Antonelli wrapped up the drivers' championship.
